requestParaphrase: Continue unfinished Proto-UI 0.3 repairs and carry the completed fixes into a reviewable follow-up PR.

governedFacts.fact: Compatibility underline is separate from upstream line; Base owns selection, hover, focus and disabled state. Default/underline/default withdraws and restores contributions.
Style changes retain the owned leaf, caller nodes, handles and focus; fixed decorative A11y exclusion remains. No DOM querying or rebinding is added in the Prototype.
Emulated-host appearance checks and native narrow layout, geometry, keyboard/focus and switching are separate evidence; native gate remains incomplete until exact-source browser execution.

implementation.causalTrace: Permanent empty owned decoration is positioned absolute only for appearance=default. Underline host uses inline-flex gap-1, so its otherwise in-flow empty decoration contributes the observed 4 px gap. A conditional absolute opacity-0 contribution removes unused decoration from flow while retaining node and ownership.

fixture.causalTrace: Initial WC runtime is selected with a native click. The still-hovered inactive tab intentionally uses selected foreground, while the final assertion compares resting inactive versus selected ink. Move pointer away and poll both native :hover and exposed hovered before the resting measurement.

negativeBoundaries: Do not weaken 2 px width bound, color inequality, narrow width, keyboard, focus, selected count, event order or disconnection assertions
Do not remove decoration or replace Base owner
Do not change original formal CI/source guard or fake CI
No spec lifecycle promotion, Adapter changes, preset or native acceptance claim
consumers: Four-family Runtime Tabs public Form previewers
plannedValidation: Exact four new emulated-host regressions red on baseline then green on candidate
Relevant existing Tabs scope chosen from current catalog/consumer graph
Type and formatting checks proportional to three-file change
Parent-owned hosted native four-case rerun remains pending
knownLimitations: HappyDOM generated CSS is flattened from @layer only in the test
Unit test does not measure real browser text width
Historical exact 73-test scope was not recovered
